capabilities: : Redirect multiple links to a single target note
extras: Supports development via donations; forwarding notes are automatically moved to a designated folder.
intentEvidence: FastForwardLink solves this by turning alias notes into lightweight redirects.
motivation: The author built it to allow users to write naturally without fragmenting their vault structure due to inconsistent terminology.
problem: Inconsistent terminology (abbreviations, nicknames, alternate spellings) causes Obsidian to create duplicate notes and fragment the knowledge base.
summary: FastForwardLink allows multiple note names (aliases) to redirect to a single canonical target note, streamlining navigation and organizing synonyms.
